items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: And we had picked up Helen Humes... I do know Helen was in the Famous Door... pictures of me and Joe Jones and Jimmy Rushing and Helen Humes

ctx.x: : What I'm curious about though is how they managed to pay any money in a little box like that.
Well, they paid more than we got at the Savoy and that's a big place and we made thirty-three dollars a week. I guess more rich people come down in there.
: Yes. That's where the band really started to click?

items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: The one with Harry James. And the personnel is Buck Clayton and Herschel Evans... And your titles... Oh yes, everybody liked that.

ctx.x: I'll tell you what, I've got the personnel on that just let me get it.
